comment: Sevii access, the way IN: Bill's invitation in the Cinnabar Pokemon Center (pokefirered CinnabarIsland/scripts.inc, CinnabarIsland_EventScript_BillScene -- Bill waits in the Center and offers the boat trip to One Island). This is the only sourced route onto the islands before any pass exists: the ferry branches on a pass, and the Tri-Pass is granted ON One Island (sevii_meet_celio), so the chain has to start here. PUW gate: the source scene is live once the player reaches Cinnabar (Bill is simply waiting in its Pokemon Center; the game's flow presents the trip around the Cinnabar gym) -- mapped to requires.min_badges 7 (the Volcano Badge), recorded as a PUW mapping. The YESNO is the host's (the runner has no choice op; the established convention -- the fossil choice in the events prep -- is that the host supplies the answer as a transient flag): the host sets bill_trip_agreed when the player accepts. Declining plays IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter and sets NOTHING (Bill stays in the Center and the invitation re-triggers on the next talk, as in the source, where the scene var waits at 2). Accepting plays AllRightLetsGo, sets sevii_bill_sailed and warps to OneIsland_Harbor's sole warp -- Bill's boat is a scripted transfer like the Seagallop, not a warp-data edge (reachability audit B-06). NOTE on gating: this script deliberately has NO once_flag. The runner sets a script's once_flag itself whenever the script completes (PUWEventRunner._complete), so a once_flag here would land even on the DECLINE path and lock Bill away after one refusal; instead the agreed branch's own set_flag step raises sevii_bill_sailed, and requires.forbidden_flags keeps the invitation from re-firing after the sailing. All four lines are exact labels decoded into patched/data/sevii_bank_additions.json (group CinnabarIsland). Movement (Bill walking over, the boat ride) is host presentation, as in the events prep.
